title: Follow up and remove an exchange
done: That is it: a follow-up joins the chain; Remove this exchange takes the whole chain away.

steps.caption: Here a question is asked on the board.

steps.text: Why is the parser separate from the reader?
steps.caption: The question is typed…
Review sends it to the agent.

answers.text: So that the reader can serve other formats; the parser only splits fields.

steps.caption: The agent answers on the board, in a note joined to the question.
Right-click the answer to follow up: the new question joins the same chain.
Remove this exchange takes away the question, the answers and the follow-ups together.
Your turn: right-click the answer, to follow up or to remove the exchange.
